limitations: No fixed constructor count, overlap, alive/attached or last-appearance outcome is required.
All UUID lifetimes remain separate even if pointer strings are reused.
Weak liveness and last SwiftUI event are point observations; not actual presenting UIKit host, GPU work, or exact deallocation evidence.
Snapshots come from existing board checkpoints only. Brackets may span time; no claim of hand state at every instant.
Source bookkeeping can perturb timing; failure reproduction judged independently from whole images.
